tasks.title: Propose a bounded live-model adapter and mediated gateway
tasks.brief: Write a proposal only. Specify provider-neutral input/output boundaries, explicit personal spend authorization, an offline fake, failure accounting, and a mediated provider/tool gateway outside ephemeral workers. Explain how to preserve sealed truth and controller authority. Do not call a model, inspect credentials, or revise an accepted ADR. Report the exact commit, paths, commands/results, unresolved decisions, and limitations.

tasks.title: Expand receipt applicability and paired-trial regression scenarios
tasks.brief: Add offline regression scenarios through existing public interfaces, covering narrowly scoped genuine evidence, wrong issuer/claim/scope, and trial independence. Keep identical facts across paired presentations. Confine changes to owned files; report any runtime changes needed as follow-up proposals. Do not claim empirical model effects. Report the exact commit, paths, commands/results, and limitations.

tasks.title: Draft the research report with reproducible observed results
tasks.brief: Draft a report using the current official requirements linked in docs/SUBMISSION.md. Distinguish tested mechanisms, synthetic illustrations, hypotheses, and unbooted Nix configuration. Include solo authorship, AI assistance, prior-work provenance, limitations, and dual-use analysis. Do not submit or publish. Report exact commits, reproducible commands/results, and remaining evidence gaps.

tasks.title: Independently review architecture, evidence, and delivery claims
tasks.brief: Review the exact integrated commits independently. Inspect controller invariants, paired evidence, replay text rendering, read-only serving, fleet refusal behavior, and unverified Nix deployment claims. Run commands explicitly and record failures without omission. Write findings with severity, affected paths, evidence, and recommendations; do not modify implementation, merge, spend, publish, or grant access.
